role.en: Associate Professor, Stanford; Co-founder, Physical Intelligence
role.zh: 斯坦福大学副教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人

why.en: Author of MAML and a core contributor to few-shot learning for robots — the methods that let a policy generalise from very little data.
why.zh: 元学习算法 MAML 的作者，机器人少样本学习的核心贡献者 —— 这些方法让策略可以从极少数据中泛化。

title.en: Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning (MAML)
title.zh: 模型无关的元学习（MAML）

note.en: The method that let a policy generalise from very little data.
note.zh: 让策略可以从极少数据中泛化的方法。

title.en: Stanford IRIS Lab — robot learning research
title.zh: 斯坦福 IRIS 实验室 —— 机器人学习研究

title.en: RL for dynamic tasks requires handling latency. Building on EXPO-FT, we let the base VLA operate on older images while a small edit policy operates in real time
title.zh: RL for dynamic tasks requires handling latency. Building on EXPO-FT, we let the base VLA operate on older images while a small edit policy operates in real time

note.en: Finn describes new work building on EXPO-FT that lets a VLA operate on stale image frames while a lightweight real-time edit policy compensates for latency, outperforming RTC on dynamic RL tasks.
note.zh: Finn介绍了基于EXPO-FT的新工作：让VLA基础模型在稍旧的图像帧上运行，同时由一个轻量级实时编辑策略进行延迟补偿，在动态RL任务上的表现超过了RTC。

title.en: New blog post with @perryadong on what we need for robots to be broadly useful in the real world. https://t.co/jxsNeMUhFg Reliability is the one of the biggest
title.zh: New blog post with @perryadong on what we need for robots to be broadly useful in the real world. https://t.co/jxsNeMUhFg Reliability is the one of the biggest

note.en: Finn announces a new blog post co-authored with Physical Intelligence's Perry Dong arguing that reliability is one of the biggest open challenges to making robot policies broadly useful in the real world.
note.zh: Finn宣布与Physical Intelligence的Perry Dong合作发表新博文，指出可靠性是让机器人策略在真实世界中广泛可用所面临的最大公开挑战之一。

title.en: A video from a Pi robot deployed at Dandelion Chocolate, fully autonomous w/ no interventions. 🤖 Deploying robots has taught us surprising lessons about the gap
title.zh: A video from a Pi robot deployed at Dandelion Chocolate, fully autonomous w/ no interventions. 🤖 Deploying robots has taught us surprising lessons about the gap

note.en: A Physical Intelligence Pi robot completed a fully autonomous shift at Dandelion Chocolate with no human interventions, and Finn discusses what the deployment revealed about the gap between demos and real-world robot autonomy.
note.zh: Physical Intelligence的Pi机器人在Dandelion Chocolate完成了全程无人工干预的自主作业，Finn分享了这次落地暴露出的演示与真实世界机器人自主性之间的差距。

title.en: WHALE: A Simple Recipe for Joint Harness-Weight Optimization
title.zh: WHALE: A Simple Recipe for Joint Harness-Weight Optimization

note.en: Co-authors WHALE, a method that jointly optimizes an agent's model weights and its executable harness code, outperforming approaches that tune either one alone.
note.zh: 合著WHALE方法论文，联合优化智能体的模型权重与可执行框架代码，效果优于仅优化其中一项的方案。

title.en: One of the most important aspects of scientific discovery is deciding where to draw insights from. While LLMs are promising tools for science, we lack datasets
title.zh: One of the most important aspects of scientific discovery is deciding where to draw insights from. While LLMs are promising tools for science, we lack datasets

note.en: Calls for datasets and evaluations on how LLMs can draw scientific insight from prior research, an under-studied step in AI-assisted discovery.
note.zh: 呼吁建设数据集与评测方法，用于研究大语言模型如何从已有文献中提炼科学洞见——这是人工智能辅助科学发现中尚未被充分研究的一环。

title.en: Q-Learning With World Models
title.zh: Q-Learning With World Models

note.en: Paper with Perry Dong, Yueru Jia and Dorsa Sadigh combining off-policy Q-learning with learned world models, so a robot policy can be trained from fewer interactions.
note.zh: 与 Perry Dong、Yueru Jia、Dorsa Sadigh 合著的论文，将离策略 Q 学习与学到的世界模型结合，使机器人策略可以用更少的交互数据训练出来。

title.en: Pre-training Visual Dexterity in Simulation
title.zh: Pre-training Visual Dexterity in Simulation

note.en: Pre-trains dexterous multi-finger manipulation in simulation, moving robot pre-training beyond the simple parallel-jaw grippers most datasets assume.
note.zh: 在仿真中预训练多指灵巧操作，让机器人预训练摆脱大多数数据集所假设的简单二指夹爪。

title.en: Chelsea Finn: This is the State of the Art in Robotics
title.zh: Chelsea Finn: This is the State of the Art in Robotics

note.en: Finn on the Y Combinator podcast on the state of robotics, and why reliability over long horizons — not capability demos — is the hard problem.
note.zh: Finn 做客 Y Combinator 播客，谈机器人技术现状，以及为何真正的难题是长时间任务的可靠性而非能力演示。

title.en: SpeedTuning: Speeding Up Policy Execution with Lightweight Reinforcement Learning
title.zh: SpeedTuning: Speeding Up Policy Execution with Lightweight Reinforcement Learning

note.en: Uses lightweight reinforcement learning to speed up execution of imitation-learned robot policies, which tend to inherit slow human demonstration speeds.
note.zh: 用轻量级强化学习加快模仿学习机器人策略的执行速度，这类策略往往继承了人类演示的缓慢节奏。

title.en: Pretraining a Q-function often doesn’t actually help RL finetuning, compared to initializing Q from scratch. We find that pretraining Q-functions on data from d
title.zh: Pretraining a Q-function often doesn’t actually help RL finetuning, compared to initializing Q from scratch. We find that pretraining Q-functions on data from d

note.en: Finds that pretraining Q-functions rarely helps RL finetuning unless the pretraining data comes from a diverse set of policies.
note.zh: 研究发现，预训练 Q 函数通常无助于强化学习微调，除非预训练数据来自多样化的策略集合。

title.en: Do You Really Need to Pretrain Q-Functions for Online RL Fine-Tuning?
title.zh: Do You Really Need to Pretrain Q-Functions for Online RL Fine-Tuning?

note.en: Questions whether Q-functions need pre-training at all before online RL fine-tuning of a pretrained policy.
note.zh: 质疑在对预训练策略进行在线强化学习微调之前，是否真有必要预训练 Q 函数。

title.en: PolaRiS: Scalable Real-to-Sim Evaluations for Generalist Robot Policies
title.zh: PolaRiS: Scalable Real-to-Sim Evaluations for Generalist Robot Policies

note.en: Finn co-authored PolaRiS, a scalable real-to-sim evaluation framework for testing generalist robot policies, presented at RSS 2026.
note.zh: Finn合著了PolaRiS，一个用于评测通用机器人策略的可扩展“真实到仿真”评估框架，发表于RSS 2026。

title.en: Emergence of Human to Robot Transfer in Vision-Language-Action Models
title.zh: Emergence of Human to Robot Transfer in Vision-Language-Action Models

note.en: Finn co-authored a study on how vision-language-action models can transfer skills learned from human video to robot execution.
note.zh: Finn合著了一项研究，探讨视觉-语言-动作模型如何将从人类视频中学到的技能迁移到机器人执行中。

title.en: LLM-as-a-Verifier: A General-Purpose Verification Framework
title.zh: LLM-as-a-Verifier: A General-Purpose Verification Framework

note.en: Proposes a general-purpose framework for using language models as verifiers, treating verification as the third scaling axis alongside training and test-time compute.
note.zh: 提出以语言模型作为验证器的通用框架，将验证视为与训练和推理算力并列的第三条扩展轴。

title.en: We’ve been approaching reward supervision for robots the wrong way. I think freeform preferences are part of the answer. A short 🧵 https://t.co/9DZbaf1mNX
title.zh: We’ve been approaching reward supervision for robots the wrong way. I think freeform preferences are part of the answer. A short 🧵 https://t.co/9DZbaf1mNX

note.en: Argues the field has been approaching reward supervision for robots the wrong way, and makes the case for freeform preference feedback instead.
note.zh: 她提出，机器人领域一直以错误的方式处理奖励监督问题，并主张改用自由形式的偏好反馈。

title.en: Freeform Preference Learning for Robotic Manipulation
title.zh: Freeform Preference Learning for Robotic Manipulation

note.en: Learns robot manipulation rewards from freeform human preference feedback, addressing the sparse-signal problem in long-horizon tasks.
note.zh: 从自由形式的人类偏好反馈中学习机器人操作的奖励，缓解长时程任务中信号稀疏的问题。

title.en: LLM RL optimizes for sequential reasoning We also optimize over the reasoning strategy, incl parallel trains of thought, aggregation of parallel traces, & seque
title.zh: LLM RL optimizes for sequential reasoning We also optimize over the reasoning strategy, incl parallel trains of thought, aggregation of parallel traces, & seque

note.en: Presents LLM RL that optimizes the reasoning strategy itself — parallel trains of thought, aggregation, and sequencing — not just sequential reasoning.
note.zh: 提出一种大语言模型强化学习方法，不仅优化顺序推理，还优化推理策略本身，包括并行思维链、聚合与排序。

title.en: Can we translate a rough sense for what to do + VLA prior into successful behavior? Flow reversal steering: 1) runs the VLA's flow ODE backwards to back out noi
title.zh: Can we translate a rough sense for what to do + VLA prior into successful behavior? Flow reversal steering: 1) runs the VLA's flow ODE backwards to back out noi

note.en: Introduces flow reversal steering, which runs a VLA's flow ODE backward to recover the noise closest to a coarse target trajectory.
note.zh: 提出「流反转引导」方法，通过反向运行视觉-语言-动作模型的流常微分方程，反推出最接近粗略目标轨迹的噪声。

title.en: SPIRAL: Learning to Search and Aggregate
title.zh: SPIRAL: Learning to Search and Aggregate

note.en: SPIRAL learns to allocate test-time compute across search and aggregation rather than relying on a fixed reasoning scaffold.
note.zh: SPIRAL 学习在搜索与聚合之间分配推理时算力，而不是依赖固定的推理脚手架。

title.en: How does test-time scaling impact robots? We find that larger models, more thinking, and more context help significantly for some prompts but not others. Like L
title.zh: How does test-time scaling impact robots? We find that larger models, more thinking, and more context help significantly for some prompts but not others. Like L

note.en: Finds test-time scaling — larger models, more thinking, more context — helps robot policies on some prompts but not others, motivating a learned router.
note.zh: 研究发现测试时扩展（更大模型、更多思考、更长上下文）在部分提示下能提升机器人策略表现，但并非对所有提示都有效，因而提出训练一个路由器来自动选择。

title.en: Can robot foundation models collaborate with themself? We finetune a VLA to be able to control any robot in a team. - matches or outperforms training separate m
title.zh: Can robot foundation models collaborate with themself? We finetune a VLA to be able to control any robot in a team. - matches or outperforms training separate m

note.en: Finetunes a single VLA so it can control any robot in a team, matching or beating separately trained or centralized models.
note.zh: 对单一视觉-语言-动作模型进行微调，使其能够控制团队中的任意机器人，效果可媲美甚至超过分别训练或集中式训练的模型。

title.en: Improving Robotic Generalist Policies via Flow Reversal Steering
title.zh: Improving Robotic Generalist Policies via Flow Reversal Steering

note.en: Steers generalist robot policies toward new tasks by reversing the flow of a pretrained policy instead of retraining it.
note.zh: 通过反转预训练策略的流向来引导通用机器人策略完成新任务，而无需重新训练。

title.en: DIRECT: When and Where Should You Allocate Test-Time Compute in Embodied Planners?
title.zh: DIRECT: When and Where Should You Allocate Test-Time Compute in Embodied Planners?

note.en: Studies when and where extra test-time compute actually helps vision-language models acting as high-level planners for embodied agents.
note.zh: 研究当视觉语言模型充当具身智能体的高层规划器时，额外的推理时算力究竟在何时何处才真正有用。

title.en: CHORUS: Decentralized Multi-Embodiment Collaboration with One VLA Policy
title.zh: CHORUS: Decentralized Multi-Embodiment Collaboration with One VLA Policy

note.en: CHORUS coordinates multiple robots of different embodiments on a shared task using a single decentralised VLA policy.
note.zh: CHORUS 用单一的去中心化视觉-语言-动作策略，协调不同形态的多台机器人共同完成任务。

title.en: Scaling RL to long horizons remains a major challenge. Long-horizon Q-learning (LQL) prevents compounding bootstrapping errors by bounding the difference in val
title.zh: Scaling RL to long horizons remains a major challenge. Long-horizon Q-learning (LQL) prevents compounding bootstrapping errors by bounding the difference in val

note.en: Introduces Long-horizon Q-learning (LQL), which bounds the value difference over long horizons to prevent compounding bootstrapping errors in RL.
note.zh: 提出长时程 Q 学习（LQL），通过限制长时间跨度上的价值差异，防止强化学习中的自举误差累积。

title.en: Ego-Pi: VLA Fine-Tuning for Ego-Centric Human and Robot Data
title.zh: Ego-Pi: VLA Fine-Tuning for Ego-Centric Human and Robot Data

note.en: Fine-tunes a vision-language-action model on egocentric human video alongside robot data to work around robotics' data scarcity.
note.zh: 结合第一人称人类视频与机器人数据微调视觉-语言-动作模型，以绕开机器人领域的数据稀缺问题。

title.en: How can VLAs achieve 95+% reliability? Using RL post-training with EXPO-FT: - π0.5 improves to 30/30 success on all 8 tasks tested - uses only 19 min of RL data
title.zh: How can VLAs achieve 95+% reliability? Using RL post-training with EXPO-FT: - π0.5 improves to 30/30 success on all 8 tasks tested - uses only 19 min of RL data

note.en: EXPO-FT, an RL post-training method, pushes π0.5 to 30/30 task success across 8 tasks using only about 19 minutes of RL data on average.
note.zh: EXPO-FT 这一强化学习后训练方法，平均仅用约 19 分钟的强化学习数据，就使 π0.5 在 8 项任务上达到 30/30 的成功率。

title.en: EXPO-FT: Sample-Efficient Reinforcement Learning Finetuning for Vision-Language-Action Models
title.zh: EXPO-FT: Sample-Efficient Reinforcement Learning Finetuning for Vision-Language-Action Models

note.en: A sample-efficient RL recipe for fine-tuning vision-language-action models on new manipulation tasks.
note.zh: 一种样本高效的强化学习方案，用于在新的操作任务上微调视觉-语言-动作模型。

title.en: Long-Horizon Q-Learning: Accurate Value Learning via n-Step Inequalities
title.zh: Long-Horizon Q-Learning: Accurate Value Learning via n-Step Inequalities

note.en: Improves value estimation in off-policy Q-learning over long horizons using n-step inequality constraints.
note.zh: 利用 n 步不等式约束，改进离策略 Q 学习在长时程任务中的价值估计。

title.en: Can LLMs generate new insights that build on prior research? GiantsBench is a new scientific discovery benchmark, that tests whether models can synthesize new i
title.zh: Can LLMs generate new insights that build on prior research? GiantsBench is a new scientific discovery benchmark, that tests whether models can synthesize new i

note.en: Introduces GiantsBench, a benchmark testing whether LLMs can synthesize new scientific insights by combining two parent papers.
note.zh: 提出 GiantsBench 基准，用于测试大语言模型能否综合两篇「母论文」生成新的科学洞见。

title.en: RL fine-tuning often prematurely collapses LLM entropy. Poly-EPO is a scalable set-RL algorithm that optimizes for a set of accurate solutions with diverse reas
title.zh: RL fine-tuning often prematurely collapses LLM entropy. Poly-EPO is a scalable set-RL algorithm that optimizes for a set of accurate solutions with diverse reas

note.en: Introduces Poly-EPO, a scalable set-RL algorithm that optimizes for a set of accurate but diverse reasoning solutions to counter entropy collapse.
note.zh: 提出可扩展的集合强化学习算法 Poly-EPO，优化出一组既准确又推理路径多样的解，以对抗强化学习微调中的熵坍缩问题。

title.en: FASTER makes top diffusion RL algos (eg IDQL, EXPO) computationally cheaper while retaining performance Key idea: a denoising critic that operates on noise, ena
title.zh: FASTER makes top diffusion RL algos (eg IDQL, EXPO) computationally cheaper while retaining performance Key idea: a denoising critic that operates on noise, ena

note.en: Introduces FASTER, which makes top diffusion RL algorithms like IDQL and EXPO computationally cheaper via a denoising critic operating on noise.
note.zh: 提出 FASTER 方法，通过一个作用于噪声的去噪评论器，大幅降低 IDQL、EXPO 等主流扩散强化学习算法的计算成本，同时保持性能。

title.en: Open-H-Embodiment: A Large-Scale Dataset for Enabling Foundation Models in Medical Robotics
title.zh: Open-H-Embodiment: A Large-Scale Dataset for Enabling Foundation Models in Medical Robotics

note.en: A large multi-institution dataset for medical robotics, extending the Open X-Embodiment approach to surgical and clinical settings.
note.zh: 面向医疗机器人的大规模多机构数据集，将 Open X-Embodiment 的思路扩展到外科与临床场景。

title.en: FASTER: Value-Guided Sampling for Fast RL
title.zh: FASTER: Value-Guided Sampling for Fast RL

note.en: Cuts the cost of test-time action sampling in RL by guiding the sampler with a learned value function.
note.zh: 用学到的价值函数引导采样，降低强化学习在推理时进行动作采样的开销。

title.en: Poly-EPO: Training Exploratory Reasoning Models
title.zh: Poly-EPO: Training Exploratory Reasoning Models

note.en: Trains reasoning models that explore rather than converge early, so that test-time compute keeps paying off.
note.zh: 训练能够持续探索而非过早收敛的推理模型，使推理时算力的增加持续带来收益。

title.en: $π_{0.7}$: a Steerable Generalist Robotic Foundation Model with Emergent Capabilities
title.zh: $π_{0.7}$: a Steerable Generalist Robotic Foundation Model with Emergent Capabilities

note.en: Physical Intelligence's π0.7 robotic foundation model, which follows diverse language instructions in unseen environments out of the box; Finn is a co-founder and co-author.
note.zh: Physical Intelligence 的 π0.7 机器人基础模型，可在未见环境中开箱即用地执行多样的语言指令；Finn 是该公司联合创始人与论文作者之一。

title.en: LLM post-training used to mean fine-tuning to a downstream task Robotics has been stuck in this setting, needing task-specific fine-tuning for best performance
title.zh: LLM post-training used to mean fine-tuning to a downstream task Robotics has been stuck in this setting, needing task-specific fine-tuning for best performance

note.en: Finn announces π0.7, a robot post-training approach that generalizes out of the box instead of requiring task-specific fine-tuning.
note.zh: Finn 发布 π0.7，一种无需任务特定微调、开箱即可泛化的机器人训练方法。

title.en: GIANTS: Generative Insight Anticipation from Scientific Literature
title.zh: GIANTS: Generative Insight Anticipation from Scientific Literature

note.en: Tests whether language models can anticipate new scientific insights by synthesising prior literature rather than merely summarising it.
note.zh: 检验语言模型能否通过综合已有文献来预判新的科学洞见，而不只是做摘要。

title.en: World Action Verifier: Self-Improving World Models via Forward-Inverse Asymmetry
title.zh: World Action Verifier: Self-Improving World Models via Forward-Inverse Asymmetry

note.en: Uses the asymmetry between forward and inverse dynamics to let world models verify and improve their own predictions.
note.zh: 利用正向与逆向动力学之间的不对称性，让世界模型验证并改进自身的预测。

title.en: Meta-Harness: End-to-End Optimization of Model Harnesses
title.zh: Meta-Harness: End-to-End Optimization of Model Harnesses

note.en: Optimises the harness around a language model — what it stores, retrieves and shows the model — end to end, rather than tuning weights.
note.zh: 端到端地优化语言模型外围的执行框架——它存储、检索并呈现给模型的内容——而非调整模型权重。

title.en: Agents like Claude Code do amazing things relying critically on hand-engineered harnesses We show how agents can optimize the harness w.r.t. end performance Key
title.zh: Agents like Claude Code do amazing things relying critically on hand-engineered harnesses We show how agents can optimize the harness w.r.t. end performance Key

note.en: Shows agents can optimize their own hand-engineered harness — the kind used by tools like Claude Code — for end performance by storing all experience in a filesystem.
note.zh: 研究表明，智能体可以像 Claude Code 这类工具一样，通过将全部经验存储在文件系统中，来针对最终表现优化自身的人工设计脚手架。

title.en: Usually, we expect more diverse data >> less diverse data. Cross-embodiment transfer seems to benefit from paired data across embodiments, more so than in
title.zh: Usually, we expect more diverse data >> less diverse data. Cross-embodiment transfer seems to benefit from paired data across embodiments, more so than in

note.en: Finds cross-embodiment transfer benefits more from paired data across robot embodiments than from simply increasing data diversity.
note.zh: 研究发现，跨形态迁移更多受益于不同机器人形态间的配对数据，而非单纯增加数据多样性。

title.en: We lack simulated test-beds for studying memory in robot learning. RoboMME is provides a sim benchmark for multiple forms of memory. No single method performs w
title.zh: We lack simulated test-beds for studying memory in robot learning. RoboMME is provides a sim benchmark for multiple forms of memory. No single method performs w

note.en: Introduces RoboMME, a simulated benchmark for multiple forms of memory in robot learning, finding no single method wins across all tasks.
note.zh: 提出机器人学习记忆基准 RoboMME，涵盖多种记忆形式，发现没有单一方法能在所有任务上都表现最佳。

title.en: Data Analogies Enable Efficient Cross-Embodiment Transfer
title.zh: Data Analogies Enable Efficient Cross-Embodiment Transfer

note.en: Shows that organising cross-embodiment robot data by analogy makes transfer between different robots far more efficient.
note.zh: 表明按类比关系组织跨形态机器人数据，能显著提升不同机器人之间的迁移效率。

title.en: RoboMME: Benchmarking and Understanding Memory for Robotic Generalist Policies
title.zh: RoboMME: Benchmarking and Understanding Memory for Robotic Generalist Policies

note.en: RoboMME benchmarks memory in generalist robot policies on tasks that require counting repeated actions or tracking occluded objects.
note.zh: RoboMME 针对需要计数重复动作或追踪被遮挡物体的任务，评测通用机器人策略的记忆能力。

title.en: MEM: Multi-Scale Embodied Memory for Vision Language Action Models
title.zh: MEM: Multi-Scale Embodied Memory for Vision Language Action Models

note.en: Gives vision-language-action models multi-scale memory instead of a flat window of past observations, for multi-stage real-world tasks.
note.zh: 为视觉-语言-动作模型引入多尺度记忆，取代扁平的历史观测窗口，以应对多阶段的真实任务。

title.en: We added short-term visual memory + long-term text memory to pi models. 🤖 Enables robots to: - complete tasks up to 15 min long - cook grilled cheese while keep
title.zh: We added short-term visual memory + long-term text memory to pi models. 🤖 Enables robots to: - complete tasks up to 15 min long - cook grilled cheese while keep

note.en: Adds short-term visual and long-term text memory to pi robot models, enabling tasks up to 15 minutes long, like cooking grilled cheese while tracking time.
note.zh: 为 pi 系列机器人模型加入短期视觉记忆与长期文本记忆，使其能完成长达 15 分钟的任务，例如一边计时一边煎芝士三明治。

title.en: Pi models are now running in production settings, in collab with @Ultraroboticsco and @weaverobotics. We see: - much higher autonomy with pi-0.6 over using pi-0
title.zh: Pi models are now running in production settings, in collab with @Ultraroboticsco and @weaverobotics. We see: - much higher autonomy with pi-0.6 over using pi-0

note.en: Reports pi robot models now running in production with partner robotics companies, showing higher autonomy and fewer mistakes than pi-0.5.
note.zh: 报告 pi 系列机器人模型已在合作机器人公司的生产环境中运行，相比 pi-0.5 自主性更高、失误更少。

title.en: We can improve VLA generalization to new instructions at test time by: 1. run rephrased lang instructions through model 2. use verifier to select best action Pa
title.zh: We can improve VLA generalization to new instructions at test time by: 1. run rephrased lang instructions through model 2. use verifier to select best action Pa

note.en: She shares a method to improve vision-language-action model generalization at test time by rephrasing instructions and using a verifier to pick the best action.
note.zh: 她分享了一种在测试时提升视觉-语言-动作模型泛化能力的方法：改写指令并用验证器挑选最佳动作。

title.en: Video gen models make pretty videos, but lack physical accuracy Large robot data is helpful but insufficient, esp since this data is mostly demos By fine-tuning
title.zh: Video gen models make pretty videos, but lack physical accuracy Large robot data is helpful but insufficient, esp since this data is mostly demos By fine-tuning

note.en: Shows fine-tuning video generation models on real policy data yields far more physically accurate video, addressing a key weakness of video models.
note.zh: 研究表明，用真实策略数据对视频生成模型进行微调，能显著提升视频的物理准确性，弥补了视频生成模型的一大弱点。

title.en: Scaling Verification Can Be More Effective than Scaling Policy Learning for Vision-Language-Action Alignment
title.zh: Scaling Verification Can Be More Effective than Scaling Policy Learning for Vision-Language-Action Alignment

note.en: Argues that scaling verification beats scaling policy learning for aligning vision-language-action models with language instructions.
note.zh: 论证在让视觉-语言-动作模型对齐语言指令这一问题上，扩展验证比扩展策略学习更有效。

title.en: VLAW: Iterative Co-Improvement of Vision-Language-Action Policy and World Model
title.zh: VLAW: Iterative Co-Improvement of Vision-Language-Action Policy and World Model

note.en: Paper on VLAW, which improves a vision-language-action policy and a world model jointly through repeated online interaction.
note.zh: 论文提出 VLAW，通过反复的在线交互让视觉-语言-动作策略与世界模型相互迭代改进。

title.en: Larger transformers often make for worse value functions. Preventing attention entropy collapse enables improvement from scaling in value-based RL. Paper: https
title.zh: Larger transformers often make for worse value functions. Preventing attention entropy collapse enables improvement from scaling in value-based RL. Paper: https

note.en: Finds that preventing attention entropy collapse lets larger transformers scale as value functions in RL, reversing the usual degradation with size.
note.zh: 研究发现，防止注意力熵坍缩后，更大的 Transformer 可以在强化学习中作为价值函数继续随规模提升表现，扭转了通常「越大越差」的现象。

title.en: SteerVLA: Steering Vision-Language-Action Models in Long-Tail Driving Scenarios
title.zh: SteerVLA: Steering Vision-Language-Action Models in Long-Tail Driving Scenarios

note.en: Applies VLA steering to autonomous driving, joining high-level semantic reasoning about long-tail events to low-level reactive control; a Stanford–Berkeley collaboration with Levine and Sadigh.
note.zh: 将视觉-语言-动作模型的引导方法用于自动驾驶，把针对长尾事件的高层语义推理与低层反应式控制结合起来；这是与 Levine、Sadigh 合作的斯坦福—伯克利研究。

title.en: Video models serve as a good pretrained backbone for robot policies. Paper: https://t.co/Q5OZNCOn5E Code: https://t.co/r0nlZq4J36
title.zh: Video models serve as a good pretrained backbone for robot policies. Paper: https://t.co/Q5OZNCOn5E Code: https://t.co/r0nlZq4J36

note.en: Shows pretrained video models serve as a strong backbone for robot policies.
note.zh: 研究表明，预训练视频模型可作为机器人策略的良好骨干网络。

title.en: Studying generalist reward models is hard: robot datasets focus on successful demos, not failures. We introduce: - a large-scale reward modeling benchmark - a d
title.zh: Studying generalist reward models is hard: robot datasets focus on successful demos, not failures. We introduce: - a large-scale reward modeling benchmark - a d

note.en: Introduces a large-scale generalist reward-model benchmark and data augmentation scheme built with failure data, since robot datasets are mostly successful demos.
note.zh: 提出大规模通用奖励模型基准与数据增强方案，专门引入失败数据，弥补机器人数据集大多只包含成功演示的不足。

title.en: RoboReward: General-Purpose Vision-Language Reward Models for Robotics
title.zh: RoboReward: General-Purpose Vision-Language Reward Models for Robotics

note.en: Finn co-authored RoboReward, a general-purpose vision-language reward model that matches human-provided rewards in real robot reinforcement learning.
note.zh: Finn合著了RoboReward，一个通用视觉-语言奖励模型，在真实机器人强化学习中的表现可媲美人工评分。

title.en: We did a fun side project of fine-tuning π’s latest model on most of the tasks from Benjie Holson’s “Robot Olympics” blog post. The robot was able to autonomous
title.zh: We did a fun side project of fine-tuning π’s latest model on most of the tasks from Benjie Holson’s “Robot Olympics” blog post. The robot was able to autonomous

note.en: Side project fine-tuning π's latest model to autonomously complete all 10 tasks from Benjie Holson's 'Robot Olympics' blog post.
note.zh: 一个业余项目：对 π 系列最新模型进行微调，使其自主完成 Benjie Holson「机器人奥运会」博文中的全部 10 项任务。

title.en: All of my Deep RL course lecture videos from Spring 2025 are now online! 🥳 Youtube playlist: https://t.co/o5ykWMaWbQ
title.zh: All of my Deep RL course lecture videos from Spring 2025 are now online! 🥳 Youtube playlist: https://t.co/o5ykWMaWbQ

note.en: Releases all Spring 2025 Deep RL course lecture videos on YouTube.
note.zh: 在 YouTube 上发布 2025 年春季深度强化学习课程的全部讲座视频。

title.en: How can neural nets learn from experience without the scalar reward bottleneck? Feedback descent enables long-term iterative improvement from text feedback. Blo
title.zh: How can neural nets learn from experience without the scalar reward bottleneck? Feedback descent enables long-term iterative improvement from text feedback. Blo

note.en: Introduces feedback descent, letting neural nets iteratively improve from text feedback instead of a scalar reward, for both robotics and LLMs.
note.zh: 提出「反馈下降」方法，使神经网络能够依靠文本反馈而非标量奖励进行持续迭代改进，适用于机器人与大语言模型。

title.en: For robots to be actually useful, they need to be reliable. We’re sharing an RL recipe for VLA models that takes a step in this direction, allowing robots to op
title.zh: For robots to be actually useful, they need to be reliable. We’re sharing an RL recipe for VLA models that takes a step in this direction, allowing robots to op

note.en: Finn's team releases an RL recipe for vision-language-action models that lets robots operate reliably and autonomously for hours.
note.zh: Finn 团队发布了一套强化学习方案，让视觉-语言-动作机器人能够可靠地自主运行数小时。

title.en: Most VLAs have no memory. MemER is a scalable method for giving VLAs long-term visual memory. Key ideas: - relevant info is in a small # of frames: store just a
title.zh: Most VLAs have no memory. MemER is a scalable method for giving VLAs long-term visual memory. Key ideas: - relevant info is in a small # of frames: store just a

note.en: Introduces MemER, a scalable method giving VLAs long-term visual memory by storing only a small number of relevant key frames.
note.zh: 提出可扩展方法 MemER，通过仅存储少量关键帧，为视觉-语言-动作模型赋予长期视觉记忆。

title.en: Ctrl-World is a controllable world model that generalizes zero-shot to new environments, cameras, and objects. Paper: https://t.co/Bog5hk0h28 Model & code:
title.zh: Ctrl-World is a controllable world model that generalizes zero-shot to new environments, cameras, and objects. Paper: https://t.co/Bog5hk0h28 Model & code:

note.en: Introduces Ctrl-World, a controllable world model that generalizes zero-shot to new environments, cameras, and objects.
note.zh: 提出可控世界模型 Ctrl-World，能够零样本泛化到新的环境、摄像机视角与物体。

title.en: Flow matching for value functions. Works well for both offline and offline-to-online RL. Paper: https://t.co/SKWIeGMMeY https://t.co/ajrbBqN8fs
title.zh: Flow matching for value functions. Works well for both offline and offline-to-online RL. Paper: https://t.co/SKWIeGMMeY https://t.co/ajrbBqN8fs

note.en: Applies flow matching to value functions, working well for both offline and offline-to-online RL.
note.zh: 将流匹配方法应用于价值函数，在离线强化学习及离线到在线的迁移场景中均表现良好。

title.en: Hierarchical RL for LLM reasoning. Paper: https://t.co/uCq3Pl7Zce
title.zh: Hierarchical RL for LLM reasoning. Paper: https://t.co/uCq3Pl7Zce

note.en: Applies hierarchical RL to LLM reasoning.
note.zh: 将分层强化学习方法应用于大语言模型的推理。

title.en: RL fine-tuning often prematurely collapses policy entropy. We consider a general framework, called set RL, i.e. RL over a set of trajectories from a policy. We
title.zh: RL fine-tuning often prematurely collapses policy entropy. We consider a general framework, called set RL, i.e. RL over a set of trajectories from a policy. We

note.en: Introduces set RL, optimizing over a set of trajectories from a policy to counter the premature entropy collapse of RL fine-tuning.
note.zh: 提出「集合强化学习」，通过对策略生成的一组轨迹进行联合优化，对抗强化学习微调中过早出现的熵坍缩问题。

title.en: π0.5 weights + fine-tuning code are now open-source! https://t.co/k4IFdgnYfQ
title.zh: π0.5 weights + fine-tuning code are now open-source! https://t.co/k4IFdgnYfQ

note.en: Open-sources π0.5 model weights and fine-tuning code.
note.zh: 开源 π0.5 模型权重及微调代码。

title.en: EXPO is a new method for RL post-training of diffusion policies. With good pre-training, it’s both really stable and ~2x more efficient than the most efficient
title.zh: EXPO is a new method for RL post-training of diffusion policies. With good pre-training, it’s both really stable and ~2x more efficient than the most efficient

note.en: She introduces EXPO, an RL post-training method for diffusion policies that is about twice as efficient as prior approaches.
note.zh: 她推出 EXPO，一种用于扩散策略强化学习后训练的方法，效率约为现有方法的两倍。

title.en: Chelsea Finn: Building Robots That Can Do Anything
title.zh: Chelsea Finn: Building Robots That Can Do Anything

note.en: Finn's AI Startup School talk, tracing her path from meta-learning research to building general-purpose robot policies.
note.zh: Finn 在 AI Startup School 的演讲，回顾她从元学习研究走向构建通用机器人策略的历程。

title.en: The robot can autonomously perform a real gallbladder removal subroutine! - Successfully completed the procedure on all 8 of 8 held-out gallbladders - Uses same
title.zh: The robot can autonomously perform a real gallbladder removal subroutine! - Successfully completed the procedure on all 8 of 8 held-out gallbladders - Uses same

note.en: Finn shares results of a robot autonomously performing a real gallbladder-removal surgical subroutine, succeeding on all 8 held-out cases.
note.zh: Finn 分享了机器人自主完成真实胆囊切除手术子流程的结果，在全部8例保留测试中均成功。

title.en: We still lack a scalable recipe for RL post-training seeded with demonstration data. Many methods add an imitation loss, but this constrains learning too much.
title.zh: We still lack a scalable recipe for RL post-training seeded with demonstration data. Many methods add an imitation loss, but this constrains learning too much.

note.en: She proposes a scalable RL post-training recipe that uses demonstrations only to perturb exploration rather than constrain it via imitation loss.
note.zh: 她提出了一种可扩展的强化学习后训练方案，只用示范数据来扰动探索而非通过模仿损失加以限制。

title.en: How can robots problem solve in novel environments? We combine high-level reasoning with VLMs with low-level controllers to allow test-time problem solving. Pap
title.zh: How can robots problem solve in novel environments? We combine high-level reasoning with VLMs with low-level controllers to allow test-time problem solving. Pap

note.en: Finn's team combines VLM-based high-level reasoning with low-level controllers so robots can problem-solve in novel environments at test time.
note.zh: Finn 团队将基于VLM的高层推理与底层控制器结合，使机器人能在测试时于陷生环境中解决问题。

title.en: How do we make a scalable RL recipe for robots? We study batch online RL w/ demos. Key findings: - iterative filtered imitation is insufficient - need diverse p
title.zh: How do we make a scalable RL recipe for robots? We study batch online RL w/ demos. Key findings: - iterative filtered imitation is insufficient - need diverse p

note.en: She reports findings on scalable RL for robots, showing iterative filtered imitation is insufficient and diverse diffusion-policy data is needed.
note.zh: 她发布了关于机器人可扩展强化学习的发现：迭代过滤模仿方法不够，还需要多样化的扩散策略数据。

title.en: Most robot policies don't have any memory! This is because: - policies often perform *worse* with past observations as input - GPU memory and compute constraint
title.zh: Most robot policies don't have any memory! This is because: - policies often perform *worse* with past observations as input - GPU memory and compute constraint

note.en: Finn's team addresses the lack of memory in robot policies, tackling both performance degradation and GPU constraints to train long-context policies.
note.zh: Finn 团队解决了机器人策略缺乏记忆的问题，同时应对性能下降和GPU资源限制，以训练长上下文策略。

title.en: Introducing π-0.5! The model works out of the box in completely new environments. Here the robot cleans new kitchens & bedrooms. 🤖 Detailed paper + videos i
title.zh: Introducing π-0.5! The model works out of the box in completely new environments. Here the robot cleans new kitchens & bedrooms. 🤖 Detailed paper + videos i

note.en: Finn launches π-0.5, a robot policy that works out of the box in entirely new kitchens and bedrooms it has never seen.
note.zh: Finn 发布 π-0.5，该机器人策略无需额外训练即可在从未见过的新厨房和卧室中工作。

title.en: Data curation is crucial for post-training recipes. But how do we curate? Curation is usually manual & tedious. And, it's hard to tell if a strategy in the data
title.zh: Data curation is crucial for post-training recipes. But how do we curate? Curation is usually manual & tedious. And, it's hard to tell if a strategy in the data

note.en: She introduces an automated way to curate post-training data, addressing how hard it is to tell if a curation strategy will be reliable.
note.zh: 她推出了一种自动化的后训练数据筛选方法，解决了难以判断筛选策略是否可靠的问题。

title.en: The Robotics Revolution, with Physical Intelligence’s Cofounder Chelsea Finn
title.zh: The Robotics Revolution, with Physical Intelligence’s Cofounder Chelsea Finn

note.en: Finn on No Priors discussing Physical Intelligence's approach to robot foundation models and what still blocks general-purpose robots.
note.zh: Finn 做客 No Priors，讨论 Physical Intelligence 的机器人基础模型路线，以及通用机器人仍面临的障碍。

title.en: We can now fine-tune the 7B OpenVLA model for 50 Hz control! 🤖 Paper: https://t.co/TxQJ42lYi8 Code: https://t.co/u5nzhytzRA
title.zh: We can now fine-tune the 7B OpenVLA model for 50 Hz control! 🤖 Paper: https://t.co/TxQJ42lYi8 Code: https://t.co/u5nzhytzRA

note.en: Finn's team shows the 7B OpenVLA model can now be fine-tuned to run at 50 Hz control frequency.
note.zh: Finn 团队展示了70亿参数的 OpenVLA 模型现在可以微调到50Hz的控制频率。

title.en: LLM post-training still optimizes for aggregate preferences. Can we optimize for individual preferences, with in-context learning? Few-shot preference optimizat
title.zh: LLM post-training still optimizes for aggregate preferences. Can we optimize for individual preferences, with in-context learning? Few-shot preference optimizat

note.en: She introduces few-shot preference optimization (FSPO), letting LLM post-training personalize to individual preferences via in-context learning.
note.zh: 她推出少样本偏好优化（FSPO），通过上下文学习让LLM后训练能够针对个体偏好进行个性化。

title.en: Can we prompt robots, just like we prompt language models? With hierarchy of VLA models + LLM-generated data, robots can: - reason through long-horizon tasks -
title.zh: Can we prompt robots, just like we prompt language models? With hierarchy of VLA models + LLM-generated data, robots can: - reason through long-horizon tasks -

note.en: Finn's team shows robots can be prompted like language models, using a hierarchy of VLA models plus LLM-generated data for long-horizon reasoning.
note.zh: Finn 团队展示了机器人也可以像语言模型一样被提示，通过VLA模型层级结构和LLM生成的数据完成长时程推理任务。

title.en: Our first open-source release at Pi 🤖 - π₀ and π₀-FAST model weights - code for model, on-robot inference, & fine-tuning - fine-tuned checkpoints that can b
title.zh: Our first open-source release at Pi 🤖 - π₀ and π₀-FAST model weights - code for model, on-robot inference, & fine-tuning - fine-tuned checkpoints that can b

note.en: Physical Intelligence releases its first open-source models, π₀ and π₀-FAST, with weights and fine-tuning code.
note.zh: Physical Intelligence 发布了首个开源模型 π₀ 和 π₀-FAST，包含权重和微调代码。

title.en: Disappointed with your ICLR paper being rejected? Ten years ago today, Sergey and I finished training some of the first end-to-end neutral nets for robot contro
title.zh: Disappointed with your ICLR paper being rejected? Ten years ago today, Sergey and I finished training some of the first end-to-end neutral nets for robot contro

note.en: Finn recalls finishing training some of the first end-to-end neural networks for robot control ten years earlier with Sergey Levine, a formative moment for the field.
note.zh: Finn 回顾了十年前与 Sergey Levine 一起完成早期端到端神经网络机器人控制训练的经历，这是该领域的一个奠基性时刻。

title.en: Why is action chunking crucial for robot dexterity? 🤖 - We identify a natural tradeoff between temporal consistency and reactivity - New policy decoding techniq
title.zh: Why is action chunking crucial for robot dexterity? 🤖 - We identify a natural tradeoff between temporal consistency and reactivity - New policy decoding techniq

note.en: She explains why action chunking matters for robot dexterity, introducing a decoding technique balancing temporal consistency and reactivity.
note.zh: 她解释了动作分块对机器人灵巧性的重要性，并介绍了一种兼顾时间一致性和反应速度的解码技术。

title.en: Chelsea Finn: how to build AI that can keep up with an always changing world
title.zh: Chelsea Finn: how to build AI that can keep up with an always changing world

note.en: Finn talks with Pieter Abbeel about distribution shift, meta-learning, model editing and single-life RL.
note.zh: Finn 与 Pieter Abbeel 对谈分布偏移、元学习、模型编辑与单次生命强化学习。

title.en: Chelsea Finn: How to make artificial intelligence more meta
title.zh: Chelsea Finn: How to make artificial intelligence more meta

note.en: Stanford's Future of Everything interview on meta-learning — teaching models to learn new tasks from very little data.
note.zh: 斯坦福 Future of Everything 节目关于元学习的访谈——让模型学会用极少的数据掌握新任务。

title.en: Episode 19 - Chelsea Finn
title.zh: Episode 19 - Chelsea Finn

note.en: Finn appears as the guest on Eye on A.I. episode 19, discussing her path into robotics research and her work in meta-learning.
note.zh: Finn作为嘉宾出现在Eye on A.I.播客第19期，讲述她进入机器人研究领域的历程及元学习方面的工作。

title.en: Chelsea Finn: The 100 Most Influential People in AI 2026
title.zh: Chelsea Finn: The 100 Most Influential People in AI 2026

body.en: Named to Time's 2026 list of the 100 most influential people in AI.
body.zh: 入选《时代》周刊 2026 年“人工智能领域最具影响力 100 人”名单。
